recent_excerpts: Google's September Pixel bulletin patches CVE-2026-58704, a high-severity modem privilege-escalation flaw under limited, targeted exploitation, plus 109 other bugs.
Check Point Research found a DeepSeek-generated sample using Chrome's File System Access API to encrypt Android photo directories — no native payload or exploit required.
Google Project Zero found a Pixel 10 VPU driver flaw allowing userspace to map arbitrary physical memory, including the kernel image. Exploit required 5 lines of code.
